summary.zh-TW: 輸入密碼時，四格強度條一次只動一格：變強時從左往右一格填滿才換下一格，變弱時從右往左清空；顏色從紅、橘、藍到綠。下方的條件符合時小方塊變綠（只是顯示狀態，不是按鈕）。
summary.en: As you type, the four-segment meter moves one segment at a time — each fills completely before the next starts, and weaker passwords empty from the right — shifting from red through amber and blue to green. Met requirements turn their bullet green (status only, not a control).

text.zh-TW: 強度條用時間軸把每一格排成「前一格填滿、下一格才開始」，不用 stagger（stagger 會讓好幾格同時在長）。變弱時先從最右邊清空。
text.en: A timeline queues the segments so each starts only after the previous is full — not stagger, which overlaps them. Weaker passwords empty from the right first.

text.zh-TW: 強度的顏色寫成 CSS 變數放在卡片上，強度條和文字一起換色；亮暗模式各自有對應的顏色。
text.en: The strength colour is a CSS variable on the card, so the bar and label change together, with matching colours in light and dark mode.

text.zh-TW: 條件清單只是顯示狀態，不能點，所以不用方框和勾勾（看起來像可以勾選）。改成小方塊項目符號，符合時變綠並輕輕放大一下。
text.en: The requirement list only shows status and can’t be clicked, so boxes and ticks (which look tickable) are replaced by small bullets that turn green with a gentle pop.

text.zh-TW: 強度文字（Weak、Strong）放在 aria-live 區塊，讀屏使用者打字時也會聽到強度變化。
text.en: The strength label sits in an aria-live region, so screen-reader users hear it change as they type.
